name: MCP Rust SDK
description: Build MCP servers and clients in Rust with the official async SDK — Tokio-based transports, typed tool schemas, and macro-driven handler registration.

skills.name: Async Server
skills.description: Implements MCP servers on the Tokio runtime with async tool handlers and structured cancellation support.

skills.name: Macro Tooling
skills.description: Derives MCP tool schemas from Rust types and function signatures using procedural macros, avoiding hand-written JSON.

skills.name: Transport Layer
skills.description: Provides stdio, child-process, and streamable HTTP transports behind a common trait for swapping deployment modes.
